cells.display: Purpose: To break down each company’s ROE into Net Margin, Asset Turnover, and Equity Multiplier to understand what is driving performance over time.
Concluding Statement: CMG shows the strongest and most consistent ROE drivers. SHAK’s weaker margins limit its ROE, while WING and YUM have negative equity that makes ROE less meaningful.
Overall, CMG demonstrates the healthiest financial performance.
Purpose: To evaluate each company’s liquidity, leverage, efficiency, and profitability using key financial ratios in order to compare performance trends across CMG, SHAK, WING, and YUM.
Conclusion Statement: CMG shows the strongest ratios. SHAK has weak margins, and WING and YUM’s negative equity makes certain ratios unreliable. Overall, CMG performs the best.
Purpose: To estimate CMG’s intrinsic value using peer valuation multiples (P/E, P/S, and P/B) and compare it to the current share price.
Conclusion Statement: The valuation results show CMG’s estimated value is above its current price, suggesting the stock is undervalued and supports a BUY recommendation.
